## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. For lexical changes, identify the exact headword, part of speech, source record and sense.

## Evidence and rights

List reliable sources, authors or institutions, URLs, revisions or versions, applicable source-specific terms and the intended adaptation. Explain how the evidence matches this sense.

## Verification

List checks actually run, affected entry/hash or manifest evidence, and remaining uncertainties. Distinguish automated checks from linguistic review.

- [ ] Entries and canonical documentation remain English Markdown.
- [ ] Original source values, attribution and source-specific notices are preserved.
- [ ] No private captures, secrets or unreviewed etymology prose are included.
- [ ] Missing evidence is explicit; no unsupported fields were invented.
- [ ] The owner @figueirego must review and approve before merge.

A PR author cannot approve their own PR. No automated review replaces the owner's approval.
